summary: Enumerated the memos API surface mechanically from the pinned web/src (21 axios helpers, 20 method+path pairs) and published it as evidence with the source digest, session model, and the two client-only surfaces (filter/search and preferences never hit the API). Implemented the frozen same-origin projection: 18 projected endpoints over an in-memory synthetic store, deterministic mutation clock, per-request ledger with byte digests, distinguishable unknown-vs-withheld refusals, and a behavior digest over a transcript covering every endpoint. Committed the seed as fixture data with a drift test. 16 new tests; whole repo green (tsc, lint 0 errors, 167 files / 1439 tests).
